patch.value: Capacity-aware lane admission and continuation packets
Track https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/issues/99 and coordinate with companion item pm-cli-website-8yz0.
Declare and observe windowed capacities, enforce counted admission for next and start, fence interruptions across reclaim, and transfer a bounded continuation packet in Git and shared tracker modes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Baseline reproduced in a real non-Git tracker: capacity and interrupt were missing, capacity flags on next/start and continuation on brief were rejected, and plain next admitted two workers without a quota bound. Implementing five pushed slices with native revision checks and a real process race.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Slice 1: capacities are native tagged items and each observation is revision-checked and appended to the item history. The read model uses the last two in-window points when both are at most 24 hours old. Revert proof: replacing the forecast with null failed the historical 56 + 8/7 forecast assertion; restored the implementation.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Slice 2: next and start share primary capacity admission with dry-run and report measured refusal context and the next fallback command. Two independent next processes on disjoint work produced one admitted lane and one capacity_exhausted refusal. Revert proof: ignoring occupied slots admitted both workers; the process test failed with exits 0 and 0. The weekly replay produced 57.14 percent and three admitted lanes using the supplied readings and illustrative observation times.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Slice 3: one guarded native mutation records the stopped lane generation and the exhausted window. Reclaim preview and apply preserve the stopped claim until reset. An exact retry appends no duplicate record, and another generation is refused. Revert proof: bypassing the interruption check in reclaim changed the preview from refused to recovered and failed the test.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Slice 4: continuation commits the receiver, new token, capacity binding and packet under one native history guard. The packet replays linked files, sync paths, comments and tests in native order and reports the worktree commit IDs and dirty paths. Revert proof: dropping Git evidence failed the Git packet assertions, and skipping the native transfer failed the history and owner assertions. Independent forecast reverts also proved that disabling staleness or source-label screening fails the capacity test.

value.command: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=2 --test-name-pattern 'packed .* admits and transfers windowed capacity lanes' test/install.acceptance.ts

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Slice 5: the README replay and descriptive help cover capacity admission and transfer. Fair schedule uses the same admission path and retains its flags in fallback commands. Git start also preserves a shared-mode interruption. Revert proof: reverting band help failed the help assertion, and removing the Git start guard caused the interrupted lane restart test to fail.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final local verification: 741 selected tests across 59 files passed after rerunning the complete corrected privacy-sink suite and its documentation checks. The inventory covers 31 native and backend writers, including 22 history-guarded sites, with 155 privacy refusal cases and zero durable changes. All 3 linked commands passed (12 capacity, 2 continuation, 2 packed npm and Bun cases). The 2 public-corpus test cases and deadlock observation passed. Typecheck, lint, build, docstrings, duplication, identity and changelog checks passed. Repository coverage and full release execution remain with CI.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Exact-head CI for 2b0150c passed Node 22 and CodeQL. Node 26 passed 1281 tests and failed the unchanged coverage thresholds at 99.59 percent statements and lines, 98.67 percent branches, and 99.76 percent functions. Run: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/actions/runs/45587781231. Added ten real-tracker tests for malformed records, late resets, native fences, receiver slot reuse, absent Git provenance and Git ref movement. The new linked test passed 10 of 10. Reverting the README alone failed its runnable example assertion.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Follow-up verification: scoped branch diagnostics reached every branch in capacity, interruption and continuation after exercising quoted fallback arguments, invalid native generations, empty activity and incompatible command boundaries. The action selector now validates its own keys before an exhaustive dispatch. The 281-test command and lease selection passed, the updated linked boundary suite passed 12 of 12, and both packed npm and Bun cases passed again. Project coverage thresholds remain unchanged for CI certification.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: CI at b04441b reported 100 percent statements, functions and lines and 99.77 percent branches. The Node 26 suite also caught the missing subprocess deadline in the Git interleaving fixture. Run: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/actions/runs/45592190671. Added the deadline and reran the inventory with the boundary suite. Remaining branch locations from that report are exercised by the command boundary tests and the exhaustive action dispatch.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Resumed draft PR #102 at bb87576 and reviewed the packed-build replay. Plan: distinguish full lane pools, add conservative dual forecasts, and allow the current holder to reread the stored continuation. Preserve reporter inputs, SDK fencing, and the documented ordered fallback command.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Packed-build finding 1: full pools now return capacity_lanes_occupied with active/admitted counts, reset and one runnable retry. Reported and measured exhaustion and over-limit forecasts retain distinct codes. Real processes execute the Ollama fallback for each refusal. Revert proof: restoring capacity_exhausted for the occupied branch made the final-slot race fail on the code assertion.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Packed-build finding 2: status exposes recent and whole-window forecasts, and policy selects recent, window or max (the default, including legacy policies). The supplied timestamps give 64.325% elapsed, 76.010% recent and 90.167% whole-window, admitting two lanes. Revert proof: selecting recent in the max branch made the fixed-clock test fail with 76.010 instead of the expected 90.167.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Packed-build finding 3: the current token holder rereads the saved transfer receipt without a writer lease or history append. Live reads before transfer include the current claim history. Both packet forms include linked files. Revert proof: restoring the missing-to refusal made the receiver read fail with exit 2 instead of returning the transferred packet.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Follow-up gates passed: 454 dependent and privacy tests across 41 files, five ordinary assignment brief tests, the 30-case linked capacity and continuation suite, and both packed consumers. Privacy checks rejected 27,130 unsafe invocations with zero tracker changes or partial receipts. Build, typecheck, lint, duplication (zero clones) and docstrings (266 declarations) passed. Scoped diagnostics exercised all new executable branches. The PR remains draft for exact-head CI.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Resumed at 32618fc after the packed re-test confirmed the three earlier fixes. Reproducing the whole-window forecast drift by advancing the clock without adding observations.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The whole-window projection now uses the elapsed share at the latest observation. Admission and status share this calculation. The recent projection already uses observation timestamps. The 44, 49, 55 and 58 percent replay holds at 90.16656 percent and two admitted lanes at 10:24, +85 minutes and +6 hours. After staleness both projections are unknown and the else policy applies. A new observation at +6 hours permits a third lane. Reverting only the divisor in a disposable copy made the +85-minute assertion fail at 88.99985 instead of 90.16656.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Forecast re-test passed locally. The 28 selected dependent and privacy suites passed 319 tests. The linked fixed-clock replay passed, and packed npm and Bun each passed the delayed-observation scenario with matching JSON and TOON forecasts. Build, typecheck, lint, duplication and docstrings passed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Resumed review at e3e635e. Read all four review threads. Plan to reproduce timestamp normalization, capacity rollover counts, disappearing Git worktrees and inherited capacity admission before editing the implementation.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PRRT_kwDOVLY-P8675ve7. Capacity declaration and observation share an explicit-zone calendar round-trip parser with interruption records read by continuation. Valid offsets normalize to UTC. The rejection checks cover November 31, non-leap February 29, 24:00 and malformed forms before native history changes. Restoring the permissive Date.parse path accepted the November 31 declaration and failed the rejection assertion.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PRRT_kwDOVLY-P8675vfB. Capacity counting and reclaim use the same live-interruption state at the decision time. The real tracker test admits a lane, interrupts it, checks reclaim, crosses the reset, re-declares with the same owner and token, and checks admission until reclaim frees the slot. Restoring the old occupancy predicate counted zero active lanes at reset instead of one.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PRRT_kwDOVLY-P8675vfH. Continuation and Git status use the same registered-checkout availability check. A missing directory retains branch commits and reports the checkout unavailable. An unrelated Git error remains visible. Removing the directory check from the continuation path made the live read fail with a Git probe error for the missing working directory.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PRRT_kwDOVLY-P8675vfM. Git attachment checks the retained provider against the live item snapshot before writing a claim or worktree. Retained Git bindings also pass admission on shared selection, handoff, continuation and reclaim. The same policy applies to preview and acquisition. Bypassing inherited admission on attachment let a denied provider create the lane and failed the required refusal.

value.command: node --test --test-concurrency=2 --test-name-pattern 'review (timestamp|capacity rollover|Git attachment|Git resumption|missing registered)' test/capacity-edges.test.ts test/continuation.test.ts

value.text: Resumed review at 2e9f4de and preserved the prior cutoff receipt. Read all six threads. Plan to reproduce the clock, tracker selector, Git evidence and ownership faults, and measure continuation history traversal.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PRRT_kwDOVLY-P8678Ixv. A real 1,000-revision SDK history with nine post-claim evidence edits took 1,831 ms to transfer and opened or read the item history 28 times, excluding setup. The disposable probe failed its two-read target. Deferred projection reuse because sharing verified replay between preflight and the lease requires a separate correctness and packet-parity change. History traversal remains unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PRRT_kwDOVLY-P8678IxF. Status, admission and measured exhaustion now share the observation projection at the decision clock. The test writes 100 percent followed by a future 1 percent from an ahead clock. Restoring selection from all samples reported 1 instead of 100 and missed the exhausted limit.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PRRT_kwDOVLY-P8678Ixk. Capacity refusal commands carry the effective selector relative to the invocation directory. An explicit-path test executes the refusal retry with an unrelated PM_PATH and admits the fallback. Removing the selector failed the next-command assertion.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PRRT_kwDOVLY-P8678Ix4. Continuation streams complete status paths and commit records. Synchronous Git probes have explicit buffers. The test creates 13,000 newline-containing paths and checks complete entries and exact omission counts. Restoring the buffered evidence path failed with ENOBUFS.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PRRT_kwDOVLY-P8678IyC. Every live incoming handoff rereads the bound item under the fence, including initially unbound handoffs. The regression inserts a denied binding and then a late interruption after corpus reads. Restoring the empty-order bypass returned the token and failed the rejection assertion.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PRRT_kwDOVLY-P8678IyY. Ownership publications synchronize live handoff, binding and interruption fields. Git attachment clears retired context, compensation restores valid context at the newer generation, and interrupted windows retain provider evidence with a retired token. The invariant walks shared and Git start and next, handoff, continuation, reclaim and close. Keeping the prior handoff on attachment failed with the old packet token.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Dependent capacity regression: after the exhausted window resets, reclaim must still be able to assign a new owner. Reclaim now checks the retained provider and drops an expired binding in the same fenced update. The existing reclaim test initially failed without this case and now also asserts the expired binding is absent.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final local gates passed: 1,037 tests across 72 files, with 114 focused and 923 dependent tests and zero skips. The seven PM-linked review regressions and both packed npm and Bun cases also passed. Build, typecheck, lint, duplication and docstrings passed. The privacy matrix refused 27,130 unsafe invocations with zero tracker changes and partial receipts. CI retains the full release and coverage gates at unchanged thresholds.
